notes: Change (CEO: "mute state ... should change from the number to an icon and back"): in every theme, a muted volume shows the muted-speaker icon in the theme's own line instead of a dash, and turns back into the number when unmuted.

Change (CEO: "gaps between cards are different spacing"): each theme gives the deck its portal's own margin and gap. The gaps between sections, inside sections and between the portal's cards now match, and the side touching Omen adds no…
Change (CEO: "Shortcuts can use their icon"): shortcuts on the deck show their real app icon, in its own colors, in every theme.

Fix (CEO: "controls BEHIND the swiper ... swipe separately"): a Multi section swipes on its own bar of dots along the bottom (swipe it, or tap a dot), and its controls sit above the bar. A tap or a dial drag is never taken as a swipe.
Change (CEO: "show a brief loader so that I know it took my command"): a tapped deck control shows a ring in the theme's accent until it redraws in its new state, at least briefly and at most 3 s.
